summary: Micware Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the launch of a subsidiary, Micware Spacia Co., Ltd., via a name change of an existing consolidated subsidiary (Micware Navigations Co., Ltd.) and a business/management reorganization. The DynaPlanet platform will move to Micware Spacia, and part of the existing business will transfer to Micware Automotive. The effective date is September 1, 2026. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or deal advisors are mentioned. This is a strategic reorganization and new business initiative, not a capital markets transaction. Watch for further growth strategy announcements.
